expect_red: a feature with both ends of its joint unbound lists the contact candidates, each row's Take naming its own edge and end

mutations.contract: A contact candidate's Take binds at the gap edge and end the candidate belongs to, not at the feature's first one.
mutations.note: Declared with the guard by handoff the_first_end_of_a_joint_offers_the_contact_faces_the_pane_already_holds (2026-11-19). A feature that ends two gap edges lists both edges' candidates; reading every row's edge off the first silently binds the second edge's face at the wrong joint.
